research_question: Holding the query, the candidate exposure, the selected route and the raw tool response fixed, does returning only the planned declared output fields change final-answer factual quality, and how much agent observation context does it remove?

why_not_already_covered.420_b1: varied how many tools were visible, not what a tool returned
why_not_already_covered.434_representation: varied how a capability is represented for retrieval, not the executed result
why_not_already_covered.424_final_answer: measures answer quality under capability-context reduction at the catalog level; output-field projection is never isolated
why_not_already_covered.gap: field-first execution is the part of the design not shared with ordinary Top-K tool routers, and its downstream effect has never been measured

isolation.transform_scope: agent context only; the executor record and task state keep the untransformed observation

PROJECTED+CONTRACT.observation: planned fields plus declared semantic_id / unit / qualifier contracts

ORACLE-MINIMAL.observation: only the fields the gold answer requires
ORACLE-MINIMAL.role: diagnostic bound; B1 showed ORACLE did not dominate SR-5, so over-minimizing is a live hypothesis rather than a strawman

task_surface.corpus_requirement: every raw record must carry competing content beyond the declared plan; a record whose raw field set equals its planned field set fails validation, because RAW-FULL and PROJECTED would otherwise be the same observation

dev_confirmation_governance.statement: The development screen and the confirmation arm run the same frozen corpus, generator, conditions and scorer. The screen is therefore diagnostic only. Confirmation may differ from it in exactly one preregistered respect: the runtime/model.
dev_confirmation_governance.precedent: This is the same relationship B1 (#420) has to B2 (#423): one frozen protocol, a stronger agent.
dev_confirmation_governance.if_a_design_change_is_ever_wanted_from_d: Close this experiment as consumed and preregister a successor with its own query-disjoint surface. Do not amend this one.
dev_confirmation_governance.shared_corpus_identity: both arms generate the corpus from the same frozen projection source revision, so tasks_sha256 must match across the two stages

staging.orchestration: both arms are advanced by the 0.14 conveyor controller; neither requires a manual dispatch
staging.projection_source_freeze: #506 has its own frozen implementation revision, resolved and content-checked on first dispatch and reused verbatim afterwards. It is never DOWNSTREAM_IMPLEMENTATION_SHA, which belongs to the #431/#432/#424 chain and predates every projection script.

development_screen.runtime: frozen B1 small agent Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B @ c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca
development_screen.conveyor_position: independent stage advanced before the B2 gate
development_screen.conveyor_identity: frozen projection implementation SHA, which is #506's own and never DOWNSTREAM_IMPLEMENTATION_SHA; dispatched exactly once per source revision
development_screen.rationale: reuses the exact published B1 runtime so context measurements stay comparable instead of introducing a fourth uncharacterised model; consumes no upstream artifact, so queuing it behind the frozen chain would delay development evidence for no scientific reason

confirmation.gate: appended after the conveyor reaches TERMINAL_EVIDENCE, which itself requires #423 B2 success; the workflow verifies the canonical B2 run success without reading B2 outcomes
confirmation.conveyor_position: appended after TERMINAL_EVIDENCE, never inserted into the frozen chain

promotion_gate.comparator: RAW-FULL under the same runtime and catalog
promotion_gate.note: The gate is non-inferiority on quality plus a strict reduction in observation context. A quality gain is reportable but is not required for the product claim, and a context reduction alone does not pass.

claim_boundary: On the evaluated frozen surface, returning only the planned declared fields preserved final-answer factual quality while reducing agent observation context. Population-level generalization remains #432's role.
